short_description: VPN connects but disconnects every 10 minutes
description: Working from home. Cisco AnyConnect connects fine but drops every 10-15 minutes and I have to reconnect. Home Wi-Fi is otherwise stable.
close_notes: Root cause: home router had aggressive power-saving on the Wi-Fi adapter causing idle drops. Fix: Device Manager > Network adapter > Power Management, unticked 'Allow the computer to turn off this device'. Also updated AnyConnect client to latest version. User confirmed stable for 2 days.

short_description: Remote access keeps dropping during Teams calls
description: My VPN session drops whenever I am on a Teams video call. Other times it is mostly ok.
close_notes: Root cause: Teams traffic was routed through full-tunnel VPN, saturating the user's upload bandwidth and triggering VPN keepalive timeouts. Fix: applied split-tunnel VPN profile so Teams/Office 365 traffic goes direct. Reconnected VPN, issue resolved.

short_description: Cannot connect to VPN - authentication failed
description: VPN client says 'Login failed' even though my password is correct. I changed my password yesterday.
close_notes: Root cause: VPN client had the old password cached after the user's AD password change. Fix: cleared saved credentials in the VPN client and Windows Credential Manager, user logged in with new password and approved MFA prompt. Connected successfully.

description: Getting 'Certificate validation failure' when connecting to VPN since this morning.
close_notes: Root cause: laptop missing the renewed corporate root CA certificate because it had not been on the network for group policy refresh. Fix: connected via office network, ran 'gpupdate /force', verified new root CA present in Trusted Root store. VPN connects normally.

short_description: Wi-Fi in conference room 4B not connecting
description: Laptops cannot connect to CORP-WIFI in conference room 4B. Shows 'Can't connect to this network'.
close_notes: Root cause: access point AP-4B-02 had hung after firmware update. Fix: rebooted the access point remotely from the wireless controller and confirmed clients associating. Scheduled firmware re-check for all 4th floor APs.

short_description: Laptop connected to Wi-Fi but no internet
description: Wi-Fi shows connected to CORP-WIFI but browser says no internet. Colleague next to me works fine.
close_notes: Root cause: laptop had a stale static DNS entry left from a previous home setup. Fix: set adapter IPv4 DNS back to 'Obtain automatically', ran 'ipconfig /flushdns' and 'ipconfig /renew'. Internet access restored.

description: Wi-Fi speed on the 3rd floor is extremely slow since Monday, pages take a long time to load.
close_notes: Root cause: channel interference - two new APs installed on the same 5GHz channel. Fix: enabled automatic channel assignment (RRM) on wireless controller and re-balanced channels. Throughput back to normal per speed tests.

short_description: Internal website not opening - DNS error
description: intranet.company.local shows 'This site can't be reached - DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN'. Google works fine.
close_notes: Root cause: user's laptop was using public DNS (8.8.8.8) which cannot resolve internal domains. Fix: reverted DNS settings to DHCP-provided corporate DNS servers and flushed DNS cache. Intranet loads correctly.

short_description: Multiple users cannot reach SharePoint site
description: Several people in Finance cannot open the Finance SharePoint site; name not resolving.
close_notes: Root cause: DNS record for the SharePoint alias was accidentally deleted during cleanup. Fix: recreated the CNAME record on the internal DNS server and waited for TTL. Verified resolution from Finance VLAN. Added record to change-protected list.

description: Outlook desktop app hangs at 'Loading Profile' and never opens. Webmail works fine.
close_notes: Root cause: corrupted Outlook profile. Fix: Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles, created a new profile and set it as default, removed the old one. Outlook opened and re-synced mailbox. Advised user to keep OST size under 50GB.

description: Outlook prompts for my password every few minutes even after I enter it correctly.
close_notes: Root cause: stale cached credentials after password change, conflicting with modern authentication. Fix: removed all MicrosoftOffice entries from Windows Credential Manager, signed out of Office apps, restarted and signed in again. No further prompts.

description: My emails stay in the Outbox and are not being sent. Receiving emails works.
close_notes: Root cause: a 45MB attachment exceeded the 25MB send limit and blocked the outbox queue. Fix: moved the large email to Drafts, shared the file via OneDrive link instead. Remaining emails sent immediately.

description: Search in Outlook returns no results or only old emails from last year.
close_notes: Root cause: Windows Search index for Outlook was corrupted/incomplete. Fix: Control Panel > Indexing Options > Advanced > Rebuild index. Ensured Outlook is included in indexed locations. Search working after re-index completed (approx 2 hours).

short_description: Shared mailbox not showing in Outlook
description: I was given access to the HR shared mailbox but it does not appear in my Outlook.
close_notes: Root cause: auto-mapping takes time to apply after permissions are granted. Fix: verified Full Access permission in Exchange admin, restarted Outlook after 1 hour; mailbox auto-mapped. Alternative documented: File > Account Settings > More Settings > Advanced > Add mailbox.

short_description: Laptop very slow after Windows update
description: Since last night's Windows update my laptop takes 10 minutes to boot and everything is slow.
close_notes: Root cause: update was still completing background installation and Windows Search was re-indexing. Fix: allowed update to finish, restarted twice, disabled 3 unnecessary startup apps via Task Manager. Boot time back to under 1 minute.

description: My laptop crashed with blue screen CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED twice today.
close_notes: Root cause: corrupted system files. Fix: ran 'sfc /scannow' and 'DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth' from elevated prompt, both repaired files. Updated storage driver. No BSOD in 3 days of monitoring.

short_description: Cannot install software - admin rights required
description: Trying to install Python for a project but Windows asks for administrator password.
close_notes: Standard users do not have admin rights by policy. Fix: installed Python 3.12 from the Company Portal (Software Center) self-service catalog, which installs with elevated rights. Showed user how to find approved software there.

description: Microsoft Teams opens with a blank white screen and nothing loads.
close_notes: Root cause: corrupted Teams cache. Fix: fully quit Teams, deleted contents of %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams (classic) / reset the new Teams app via Settings > Apps > Microsoft Teams > Reset. Teams loaded normally after sign-in.

short_description: Teams calls - others cannot hear me
description: In Teams meetings nobody can hear me, but my headset works in other apps.
close_notes: Root cause: Teams was using the laptop's internal microphone device which was muted at hardware level. Fix: Teams > Settings > Devices, selected the headset as microphone and speaker, ran test call. Audio working.

description: Charging light is on but battery percentage does not increase, stuck at 15%.
close_notes: Root cause: faulty power adapter delivering low wattage (laptop showed 'slow charger' warning). Fix: replaced with a new 65W adapter from stock. Battery health checked at 92%. Charging normally.

description: Laptop gets very hot and suddenly turns off, especially during video calls.
close_notes: Root cause: dust-clogged cooling fan and outdated BIOS with poor fan curve. Fix: cleaned fan and vents, updated BIOS to latest version via vendor tool, advised using laptop on hard surface. No shutdowns after fix.

description: My external monitor shows 'No signal' when connected through the docking station.
close_notes: Root cause: outdated docking station firmware and display driver. Fix: updated dock firmware and Intel graphics driver, reseated USB-C cable. Monitor detected; set extended display in Display settings.

description: Second screen keeps flickering every few seconds.
close_notes: Root cause: damaged HDMI cable. Fix: replaced HDMI cable with a new certified cable. Also set refresh rate to 60Hz in display settings. Flicker resolved.

description: Some keys on my laptop keyboard (E, R, T) stopped working.
close_notes: Root cause: liquid spill damage under keyboard. Fix: provided temporary USB keyboard, raised vendor warranty case, keyboard assembly replaced by vendor technician next day. Verified all keys working.

description: C drive shows only 2GB free and laptop is warning low disk space.
close_notes: Fix: ran Disk Cleanup including Windows Update cleanup (freed 18GB), enabled Storage Sense, moved user's Downloads archive to OneDrive with Files On-Demand. 45GB free after cleanup.

description: Laptop shows SMART warning: 'hard disk failure imminent, back up your files'.
close_notes: Root cause: failing SSD (reallocated sectors increasing). Fix: backed up user data to OneDrive immediately, replaced SSD under warranty, re-imaged laptop with standard build and restored data. User back up and running same day.

description: Print jobs to PRN-2F-01 sit in the queue and never print.
close_notes: Root cause: stuck print spooler on print server. Fix: restarted Print Spooler service on PRINTSRV01, cleared stuck jobs from queue. Printer resumed printing all queued jobs.

description: When I try to add the printer PRN-3F-02 I get error 0x0000011b.
close_notes: Root cause: Windows security update requires printer drivers to be installed by admin. Fix: deployed the approved printer package via Company Portal which installs the driver with elevated rights. Printer added successfully.

short_description: Database connection timeout in CRM app
description: CRM application shows 'Database connection timeout' for all sales users since 10 AM.
close_notes: Root cause: SQL Server connection pool exhausted due to a long-running blocking query from a scheduled report. Fix: killed the blocking session (SPID identified via sp_who2), rescheduled the report to off-hours and added index on Orders.CustomerId. Connections normal.

description: Monthly sales report that took 2 minutes now takes over 30 minutes.
close_notes: Root cause: outdated statistics and fragmented indexes after bulk data load. Fix: rebuilt fragmented indexes and updated statistics with FULLSCAN. Added weekly index maintenance job. Report runtime back to 2 minutes.

description: Monitoring alert: DB server SQLPROD02 data drive at 97% usage.
close_notes: Root cause: transaction log grew uncontrolled because log backups had failed for 3 days. Fix: fixed backup job credentials, took log backup and shrank log file to normal size. Drive now at 61%. Added alert on backup job failure.

short_description: Oracle login error ORA-28001 password expired
description: Finance app fails to connect to Oracle with ORA-28001.
close_notes: Root cause: service account password expired per default profile policy. Fix: reset the service account password, updated it in the application's secure config, and assigned the account to a service profile with PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME UNLIMITED (per security approval). App reconnected.

description: My Windows account is locked and I cannot log in to my laptop.
close_notes: Root cause: old password saved on mobile phone email app repeatedly failing authentication. Fix: unlocked account in Active Directory, user removed and re-added email account on phone with new password. No further lockouts.

description: I forgot my password after coming back from leave.
close_notes: Verified user identity via manager confirmation. Guided user through self-service password reset portal with MFA. User logged in successfully and registered additional MFA method.

short_description: MFA prompts not arriving on new phone
description: Got a new phone and now I do not receive Authenticator approval requests.
close_notes: Root cause: Authenticator app was registered to the old device. Fix: verified identity, cleared old MFA registration in Entra ID, user re-registered Microsoft Authenticator on new phone via aka.ms/mysecurityinfo. Approvals working.

short_description: Need access to shared drive folder
description: I need access to the \\fileserver\Projects\Apollo folder for my new project.
close_notes: Obtained approval from folder owner (Project Manager). Added user to AD group 'FS-Projects-Apollo-RW'. Asked user to log off/on to refresh group membership. Access confirmed.

description: Defender quarantines our internal reporting tool every time I run it.
close_notes: Root cause: unsigned internal executable flagged as false positive. Fix: Security team verified file hash as safe, added exclusion for the signed path via Intune Defender policy and submitted file to Microsoft as false positive. Tool runs without quarantine.

description: I received an email asking me to verify my password via a link. Looks suspicious.
close_notes: Confirmed phishing. User had not clicked the link. Fix: user reported via 'Report Phishing' button, Security team purged the email from all mailboxes and blocked sender domain. Shared phishing awareness tips with user.

short_description: SAP login error after password change
description: SAP GUI shows 'Name or password is incorrect' after I changed my Windows password.
close_notes: Root cause: SAP uses a separate password not synced with Windows; user's SAP password had expired. Fix: reset SAP password via SU01 (by SAP basis team), user set new password at first login. Advised enabling SSO request for future.

short_description: Excel crashes when opening large file
description: Excel closes immediately when I open the 80MB budget workbook.
close_notes: Root cause: 32-bit Office installed, running out of memory with large workbook. Fix: uninstalled 32-bit Office and installed 64-bit Microsoft 365 Apps via Company Portal. Workbook opens without crash.
